limitations: Tier 2 coverage: all fifteen Part 9 domains merged read-only (c5c/w3b-dom1 d52bc5c, dom2 8a4ad73, dom3 4690070, domfw bcef0ab). Later domain commits are not merged; every Tier 2 measurement iterates over experience.registry.tier2_domains(), so the integrated tree measures whatever is registered with the same code.

Restricted domain worlds lack some channels (education/research have no workflow, institutions or commitment modules): those probes are recorded as not present for that world, never as 'no leak'; the remaining channels (observation, info, tool responses, event metadata, free text, identity, predicate oracles via self-goals) are probed.

Evaluation isolation (D-66) is a process boundary of one uid: Yama ptrace scope 1 keeps sibling memory unreadable, but plumbing pipes (stdout/stderr, the multiprocessing resource tracker) of the other processes can be opened through /proc; no uid or seccomp jail for the learner process. Fixed explicit seeds (e.g. SP-11.6c's held-out seeds 11-14) are guessable by a learner that attacks; only sealed seeds defeat the rebuild attack.

make() remains in-process for development and training; a learner given its object reaches the hidden grader by construction (positive control). The red-team probe of workstream O still measures make() until it is retargeted (integration note).

SP-11.6c: improvement over a frozen copy relies on the reference learner (an interface proof): Tier 1 improvement is learned inaction (equal to the do-nothing outcome); in kernel tiers its own signal (observed money) rarely moves within the budget (~580 tools in a civilisation, a few hundred decisions). An algorithmic limitation, reported as such; the criterion is not weakened.

Population private state is checked by exact values of 64 individuals' interests, satisfaction, habits, attention, preferences, beliefs, skills and knowledge; a leak through a transformed quantity (e.g. an aggregate) would need a regression probe over perturbed populations, not implemented.
aud.item events publish the population's per-item choice inputs (emb, legib, rep, terms); judged not evaluator data and left to workstream C (integration note).

SP-11.6c (wave 3b (3)): what the reference learners learn in the improvement measurement is shallow and is reported as such - Tier 1: inaction (the trained copy's score equals the do-nothing score); Tier 2 crisis: claim the coordinator's emergency fund and stop paying for parts, fuel, mutual aid and investments (beats do-nothing only through the fund); Tier 3 (design, not yet verified on a civilisation): avoid the fees and purchases that cost the person money (at best equal to do-nothing). None of this is evidence that a learner acquires the world's mechanisms; it shows that observation-only experience carries a signal a learner can improve on, per tier.

The neural ReferenceLearner does not improve over its frozen copy in the kernel tiers within a few thousand decisions (its near-uniform policy over 60-580 tools; measured in crisis) - an algorithmic limitation of that reference learner, not an environment failure. The statistical ToolValueLearner has state-independent values and one-step credit by default.
Controller labels are hidden from other participants in observation-only worlds only; the 4.0 participants contract still publishes them in id.person events.

Probe coverage: an information-flow probe can only see quantities its scenario creates. The capability-registry and science verdicts were found by code review (every relatedness computation feeding a tool result or event), not by the probes, whose scenarios publish no capabilities and file no replications; they are covered by registry-level unit tests (tests/test_v5_experience_wave3.py), not by an end-to-end scenario probe.

Filtering covers everything delivered through tools, results, events and summaries, including calls made as a participant from module processes (wave-3 fix). What a module reads directly from world state for its own physics is reviewed per module, not filtered; the curated registry (core/evaluator_only.py) is extended when probes find a new quantity (wave 3: sci relatedness verdicts, the commerce evaluator metrics).

Relatedness still gates some world rules (commerce contracts refuse a related arbiter, products refuse self-reviews): a refusal reveals one bit of the evaluator's relatedness analysis. These are commerce's integrity rules; reported, not changed.
Operator-only population controls (pop_adaptive.set_learning/freeze_copy, pop_strategic.freeze_copy) are listed to participants and refused when called.

The 4.0 training export (training/trajectories.py RecordingRunner, byte-identical 4.0 code) records an objective's shaped step reward when given one; it is not a learner interface and was left unchanged (A.1/A.5 byte identity).
Learners in the same process can always read env.world; isolation from the verifier is real only through crucible.experience.host (separate process).
